high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a YouTube video post by Narendra Modi, the Prime Minister of India. The post was made one hour ago at 9:50 AM, as indicated by the timestamp in the top left corner. The video has received 18K likes and 188 comments. The content of the post is a message expressing satisfaction with meeting UK Foreign Secretary Mr. David Lammy. Modi appreciates Lammy's contribution to the progress in their Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, which has been further strengthened by the recently concluded Free Trade Agreement (FTA).
